ATL.name: Asa Newell
ATL.detail: Newell (toe) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Lakers.

ATL.name: Keshon Gilbert
ATL.detail: Gilbert (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Lakers.

ATL.name: Mouhamed Gueye
ATL.detail: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

ATL.name: Henri Veesaar
ATL.detail: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

BKN.name: Mikel Brown Jr.
BKN.detail: Brown, who finished with 18 points (5-13 FG, 3-8 3Pt, 5-7 FT), one rebound, three assists and one steal over 25 minutes in Saturday's 124-121 loss to Atlanta, won't play in Sunday's game against Dallas, Erik Slater of ClutchPoints.com reports.

BKN.name: Grant Nelson
BKN.detail: Nelson signed a two-way contract with the Nets on Friday, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

BKN.name: Egor Demin
BKN.detail: The Nets exercised Demin's third-year team option for the 2027-28 season, Sharif Phillips-Keaton of USA Today reports Thursday.

CHA.name: Brandon Miller
CHA.detail: Miller (groin) is listed as out for Monday's game against Cleveland.

CHA.name: Moussa Diabate
CHA.detail: Diabate (quadriceps) has been downgraded to out for Monday's game against Cleveland.

CHA.name: Grant Williams
CHA.detail: Williams (hamstring) is out for Monday's game against the Cavaliers.

CHA.name: Kon Knueppel
CHA.detail: Knueppel (hamstring) was diagnosed with a left hamstring strain Sunday and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

CHA.name: Dennis Schroder
CHA.detail: Schroder has been diagnosed with a left hamstring strain and will be reevaluated in two weeks, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

CHI.name: Norman Powell
CHI.detail: Powell (shoulder) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the 76ers, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.

CHI.name: Zach Collins
CHI.detail: Collins (illness) is out for Sunday's game against Philadelphia.

CLE.name: Sam Merrill
CLE.detail: Merrill (elbow) is listed as out for Monday's game against the Hornets.

CLE.name: Jaylon Tyson
CLE.detail: Tyson (ankle) is out for Monday's game against the Hornets.

DAL.name: Morez Johnson Jr.
DAL.detail: Johnson (leg) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Pacers.

DAL.name: Sergio de Larrea
DAL.detail: De Larrea (knee) is out for Friday's game against Utah.

DAL.name: Tarik Biberovic
DAL.detail: Biberovic (heel) is listed as out for Monday's game against Sacramento.

DAL.name: Dereck Lively II
DAL.detail: Lively (foot) is listed as out for Monday's game against the Kings.

DEN.name: Julian Strawther
DEN.detail: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

DET.name: Isaiah Joe
DET.detail: Joe (hip) is out for Monday against the Wizards.

DET.name: Jalen Duren
DET.detail: Duren (hamstring) has begun on-court activity and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.

GS.name: Gary Payton II
GS.detail: Payton (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Pelicans.

GS.name: Brandon Williams
GS.detail: Williams has been ruled out for the remainder of Monday's game against the Pelicans due to a left hamstring injury, Danny Emerman of SFStandard.com reports. He'll finish with four points (2-3 FG) in two minutes.

GS.name: Will Richard
GS.detail: Richard is deciding between getting surgery or playing with a splint, Luca Evans of the San Francisco Chronicle reports.

GS.name: Kristaps Porzingis
GS.detail: Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.

GS.name: Moses Moody
GS.detail: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

GS.name: Jimmy Butler III
GS.detail: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

HOU.name: Oscar Tshiebwe
HOU.detail: Tshiebwe has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Nuggets due to an illness.

HOU.name: Clint Capela
HOU.detail: Head coach Ime Udoka stated Monday that Capela (ankle) could be cleared to return either Nov. 15 in Washington or Nov. 16 in Miami, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.

HOU.name: Steven Adams
HOU.detail: Head coach Ime Udoka said Monday that Adams could return as soon as Sunday's game at Washington, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.

IND.name: Tyrese Haliburton
IND.detail: Haliburton (hamstring) is progressing well but does not have a timetable to return, Dustin Dopirak of The Indianapolis Star reports.

IND.name: Johnny Furphy
IND.detail: Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.

IND.name: Ben Sheppard
IND.detail: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

LAL.name: Austin Reaves
LAL.detail: Reaves (illness) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Atlanta, Benjamin Royer of The Orange County Register reports.

LAL.name: Quentin Grimes
LAL.detail: Grimes (finger) is out for Monday's game against Atlanta, per Dave McMenamin of ESPN.com.

MEM.name: Isaiah Stewart
MEM.detail: Stewart (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Toronto.

MEM.name: Quinten Post
MEM.detail: Post (head) didn't return to Monday's 118-102 win over the Raptors. He ended the night with one rebound in two minutes.

MEM.name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
MEM.detail: Pippen (back) won't play in Monday's game versus the Raptors.

MEM.name: Richie Saunders
MEM.detail: Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

MIN.name: Anthony Edwards
MIN.detail: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

MIN.name: Donte DiVincenzo
MIN.detail: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

NO.name: Trendon Watford
NO.detail: Watford (ankle) is out for Monday's game versus Utah.

NO.name: Trey Murphy III
NO.detail: Murphy (knees) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Golden State.

NO.name: Zion Williamson

NO.name: Yves Missi
NO.detail: Missi (knee) is out for Friday's game against Minnesota.

SA.name: Devin Vassell
SA.detail: Vassell (groin) is out for Monday's game against the Suns, Tom Orsborn of the San Antonio Express-News reports.

SA.name: Tobias Harris
SA.detail: Harris (calf) is listed as out for Monday's game against Phoenix.

SA.name: Jayden Quaintance
SA.detail: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

TOR.name: Immanuel Quickley
TOR.detail: Quickley (hamstring) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Memphis, Esfandiar Baraheni of The Athletic reports.

TOR.name: Collin Murray-Boyles
TOR.detail: Murray-Boyles (illness) is out for Monday's game against the Grizzlies, Esfandiar Baraheni of The Athletic reports.

TOR.name: Scottie Barnes
TOR.detail: Barnes (groin) is out for Monday's game against the Grizzlies, Esfandiar Baraheni of The Athletic reports.

TOR.name: Nate Bittle
TOR.detail: Bittle (foot) is listed as out for Monday's game against Memphis.

TOR.name: Kawhi Leonard
TOR.detail: Leonard has completed treatment to reduce swelling in his left knee and he will be re-evaluated in one week, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

WSH.name: Bilal Coulibaly
WSH.detail: Coulibaly (hand) is out for Monday's game against the Pistons.

WSH.name: Tristan Vukcevic
WSH.detail: Vukcevic (hip) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Detroit.

WSH.name: Reece Beekman
WSH.detail: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.

WSH.name: Justin Champagnie
WSH.detail: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

WSH.name: Jamir Watkins
WSH.detail: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
